name: plugin.openrouter_gateway
description: OpenRouter Gateway routing, JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol engine, and Context Epoch prompt optimizer
author: Brain Harness Forge Engine

entrypoints.name: openrouter_chat
entrypoints.description: Execute chat completion via OpenRouter / Kilo Gateway with model routing and reasoning controls

parameters.name: messages
parameters.description: List of conversation message objects (role, content)

parameters.name: max_tokens
parameters.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

parameters.name: allow_fallbacks
parameters.description: Whether to allow automatic fallback to other providers

entrypoints.name: openrouter_list_models
entrypoints.description: Fetch and filter available models from OpenRouter catalogue

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Filter models by provider prefix or substring

parameters.name: modality
parameters.description: Filter models by modality (e.g. text->text, text+image->text)

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Maximum prompt price threshold per 1M tokens

entrypoints.name: openrouter_resolve_route
entrypoints.description: Intelligently match task complexity and tier to optimal OpenRouter model routes

parameters.name: task_type
parameters.description: Task description or category (e.g. reasoning, code_edit, summary)

parameters.name: budget
parameters.description: Token and cost budget preference (standard, premium, low)

entrypoints.name: openrouter_jsonrpc_call
entrypoints.description: Execute direct JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol request against OpenRouter Gateway

parameters.name: request_payload
parameters.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 request or batch request object
